basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old delivery driver based in Winnipeg, Canada, working primarily with SkipTheDishes. Outside of work, I'm passionate about playing Transport Fever 2 and enjoy visiting natural hot springs whenever I get the chance. I have a keen interest in mental health discussions, especially around bipolar disorder, as I have been managing bipolar II for several years. My online activity typically peaks in the late evenings after my shifts. I'm currently single and live with my cat, Luna.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in logistics and delivery services, gained from years of working as a courier. I've picked up a lot of knowledge about the gig economy and how different platforms operate. Additionally, I have a personal interest in mental health, particularly bipolar disorder, which stems from my own experiences and self-education through books and online forums.
